profile.summary: Hi! I'm a Systems Analysis and Development student at UFPR working as an Analytics Engineer at Cora. I move between business and tech building robust data pipelines with AWS, BigQuery, Python, Apache Airflow, and DBT. Came from web development and found in data a way to turn information into real impact. Passionate about collaboration, continuous learning, and seeing tech as a tool for inclusion.
